title: Localized text contracts
description: Localized text as string ids plus bindings (04 §15; 05 §18; 06 §43), shared by GameView and DecisionResult narration.

TextKey.description: A localization string id, never display text (04 §15; 05 §18): lowercase dotted snake_case of at most 128 characters, the ActionDefinition label rule. Interpolation data is added with its first use.

TextValue.description: A value interpolated into localized text (04 §15 'interpolation data'; 06 §43 'bindings'): a TextKey (localized in turn, so a Key such as a direction also fits), an integer (a count, a time) or a boolean.

Text.description: Localized text: a string id and its named bindings (04 §15 'localized string IDs plus interpolation data'; 06 §43 'pinned text keys and bindings'). Binding names are lowercase snake_case, at most 64 characters.
